site.name: TechToJob
site.description: TechToJob is the community where developers and builders prove their level with real code and technical companies discover them without automated filters.

footer.tagline: Technical talent connected by what you build, not by your CV.
footer.accessibility: Accessibility: built to meet WCAG AA — keyboard navigable, with visible focus and responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop.

howItWorks.titleLead: Opportunities come from writing code together,
howItWorks.subtitle: Stop piling up ignored applications. Here you build real challenges with other devs. You work in the open and prove your level with real code.

01.title: Join the community
01.description: Join the official Discord with no cost and no gatekeeping. Introduce yourself in the welcome channel and connect with other builders from minute one.

02.title: Take part in tournaments and projects
02.description: Pick an open challenge or join a group repository. Send pull requests, discuss architecture and get technical feedback from active peers.

03.title: Companies see your code live
03.description: Tech leads and recruiters watch how you solve problems in a team. If you fit their openings, they reach out directly without automated filters.

traditional.title: The frustrating traditional path
items: Endless forms that ask you to rewrite your CV over and over.
ATS filters and automated screens that discard profiles without opening a link.
Weeks or months of total silence without knowing what failed or how to improve.

techtojob.title: The TechToJob path
items: Code visible in real repositories: commits, pull requests and reviews.
Honest feedback from other developers to sharpen your technical decisions.
Real opportunities that come from collaborating, not from mass-applying.

banner.strong: No endless forms. No trick tests.
banner.rest: You take part at your own pace, whenever you can contribute.

hero.title: The community where you show what you know
hero.titleAccent: And companies come to see you
hero.subtitle: Stop sending applications nobody reads. Not one more filter discarding your code without opening it. Here opportunities come from building in public, collaborating in real tournaments and getting feedback from active developers.

dashboard.label: Platform live status
dashboard.response: [OK] Filters removed • Pull request portfolio synced

talentCompanies.titleLead: Two sides of the same table:
talentCompanies.subtitle: Whether you're looking for your next opportunity or you need to hire resourceful developers, we cut the bureaucracy to connect you directly through code.

talent.title: Publish your profile, stack and availability
talent.description: No automated ATS filters discarding you by keywords. You don't need to be a senior with 5 years of experience for people to value what you build. Show your repositories, your real commits and your availability, completely free.

companies.eyebrow: For CTOs, Tech Leads & Technical Recruiters
companies.title: Post what you're looking for and access profiles
companies.description: Watch how they solve technical problems before hiring; don't settle for a padded CV on paper. Less blind screening and far more real context by seeing their code in tournaments and collaborative projects.
companies.cta: Explore talent or post a role

torneos.subtitle: Learn by collaborating on challenges with real specs. Walk away with verifiable projects you can defend in interviews and get known by the community and technical companies.

highlight.strong: The most real proof: this very site you're looking at was born from a TechToJob tournament
highlight.rest: Here you don't build mockups to forget in a drawer. You build real projects that ship to production and solve real needs.

criteria.title: Public criteria
criteria.description: Transparent jury with a rubric known in advance: code, design, SEO and accessibility.

production.title: Real production

review.title: Open review
review.description: Honest, constructive feedback between participants and technical members.

join.label: Join the tournament in progress

01.title: The challenge opens
01.description: Clear specs, technical requirements and a defined deadline, published well in advance.

02.title: You code and collaborate
02.description: You develop in the open, ask questions and share your progress in the Discord channels.

03.description: Transparent evaluation with no ambiguity, based on objective technical and functional criteria.

04.description: The winning work comes to life in the real world and becomes your best calling card.

testimonios.subtitle: Real experiences inside the Discord. No marketing filters or inflated metrics. Qualitative opinions from builders who build in the open.

items.name: Álvaro M.
items.quote: “Finally a place where they review how I structure my pull requests instead of discarding me automatically for not having 3 years of prior experience.”

items.name: Sara G.
items.quote: “The tournament gave me a deployed repository with clean commits that I could explain point by point in my last technical interview.”

items.name: Mateo R.
items.quote: “In the Discord channel they helped me solve an architecture problem in 20 minutes with honest explanations from developers who are actively working.”

items.name: Elena V.
items.quote: “Nobody asks you to dress up your CV. You upload your repos, take part in the challenges and people see how you really work in a team.”
